new_result_requirements.fmt_original_execution: returncode0, timed_out=false, output_limit_exceeded=false, exact retained full log identity; terminal and execute_logged originals must agree.
new_result_requirements.manual_application: Exactly the four proposal paths, expected full after-apply tree1eacf and original full preimage; retain actual application records/postimages.
new_result_requirements.full_source: Actual final full inventory/postimages/raw Git metadata with original HEAD/index/config/refs equality; changed physical bytes are explicit, never labeled unchanged.
new_result_requirements.formatter_changed_paths: Use the actual fmt stage transition, not the four manual paths or historical witness delta.
new_result_requirements.single_lock: Thin main alone owns the original nonblocking EX lease throughout application, formatting and final audits; bootstrap owns no second lock descriptor.

consumer_adaptation.canonical_alignment: Bind the actual new final-format result, same-job normal supervisor and complete final inventory/Git state; preserve historical fix failure as a separate field. Align only an explicitly approved canonical tree with full actual physical equality.

consumer_adaptation.native_gates: Keep the existing fourteen phases, original stack/filter/time budgets and test collection. The ledger --lib already belongs to the original ordinary collection; no duplicated test phase is introduced here.
